The field names, types and lengths of the four schemas are fixed by this document and its own decision, and no physical column is dictated by it (ASM-3732).

The end state of a load is VALIDATED. APPROVED and IN_FORCE are reached only through the approval gate of RWB-P4-AD010-APP. The expected row count is computed from `role` and LOV-CAPABILITY at load time and is never fixed in code. The event `rwb.access.AccessPolicyChanged.v1` is published after the commit, and changes within major version 1 are additive only. The deprecation window and the retention of the fakes are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2264; GAP-0790) and are recorded with the platform contract owner.
